_howTo: walls: every wall length in mm, in order round the room from any corner, either direction. Measure at floor level with a laser meter, corner to corner, BEHIND furniture.
areaM2: optional; only when the room is simple enough to compute by hand.
columns: one entry per column; shape round|box; diameterMm = across (box: the wider face).
openings: counts per type. Count glass sliding doors as door, fixed panes as window.
sockets: power sockets only, every one in the room, including behind furniture you moved.
